top_signals.title: NATO aircraft shoot down drone over Latvia, which blames 'Russian electromagnetic warfare'
top_signals.summary: NATO fighters shot down a foreign drone over Latvia as Finland briefly restricted airspace and sea areas amid heightened Baltic security concerns.
